paragraphs: (The sons of Bebai, Ezra 2:11.) Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava: Mishnah Eruvin 2:4.[^1]

notes.text: The whole named Miqra according to the Masorah Ezra 2:11 has the sons of Bebai, and the whole Torat Emet 357 Mishnah Eruvin 2:4 names Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava. The supplied separate pointers and their full local title are preserved, without binding the biblical collective to the later sage.
